annotation.title_clean: LEGGE 23 settembre 2025, n. 132 - Disposizioni e deleghe al Governo in materia di intelligenza artificiale
annotation.title_en: Law No. 132 of 23 September 2025 - Provisions and delegations to the Government on artificial intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Repubblica Italiana (Parlamento; Gazzetta Ufficiale, Serie Generale n. 223)
annotation.summary_en: Italy's national AI law (Law 132/2025) sets human-centred principles, sector rules (health, work, justice, public administration, professions), designates AgID and ACN as national AI authorities under the EU AI Act, creates a €1bn investment line, new AI-related criminal offences and copyright rules, and delegates to the Government to align national law with the EU AI Act.
key_provisions_or_claims: Principles of transparency, proportionality, security, non-discrimination, human oversight; interpreted consistently with EU AI Act (Reg. 2024/1689)
AgID and ACN designated national AI authorities; Banca d'Italia, CONSOB, IVASS as market surveillance in finance
Sector rules: AI supports but never replaces doctors, judges and public officials; workers and clients must be informed of AI use
New criminal provisions: aggravating circumstance for AI use and offence for unlawful deepfake dissemination (art. 612-quater)
Up to €1 billion venture-capital investment in AI, cybersecurity and quantum; government delegations on EU AI Act alignment and AI liability
